Amanda (AlderBio): Quick note — pilot goes live tomorrow 08:00 SGT. Need header allowlist + mTLS peering to sg-syd edge and a fallback route to sa-east-1. Requesting temporary qps=900 for 8h. CIDR: 192.0.2.0/24. Auto-revoke at window end please.
Ben (CS): Got it. Can you confirm UTC start and expected steady vs burst? I'll flag renewal if anything looks risky.
Amanda (AlderBio): Start = 00:00 UTC. Steady ~350 qps, bursts to ~900 for 5-7m every ~15m. Renewal check in ~3w — they'd like spend+perf captured.
Priya (Network Ops): I need CIDR ownership proof (whois or ticket) and the client cert for mTLS. Also confirm header name for allowlist (e.g. `x-company-token`).
Jordan (Solutions): Draft config — confirm before I push to prod:
```
customer: alderbio
cidrs: [192.0.2.0/24]
regions: [ap-southeast-1, sa-east-1]
qps: 900
duration: 8h
auto_revoke: 2024-06-30T08:00:00Z
headers: ["x-company-token"]
mTLS: enabled
```
Ben (CS): That looks fine. I'll add a renewal risk note "watching" and arrange a post-pilot feedback call on Monday. Also request a short perf snapshot 30m after go-live.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +8k tokens/hr for alderbio during window. Approve with `/approve quota 1739999999`
Ben (CS): Approved. :white_check_mark: 
Priya (Network Ops): Applying to staging now. Smoke test: `curl -I https://proxy.sg.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Schedule prod cutover 15m before start, will monitor p50 and 5xx.
Jordan (Solutions): Prod push done at 23:45 UTC. Canary healthy at 23:52 UTC. Fallback route ready at 80% util.
Priya (Network Ops): Monitoring live metrics; ping if p50 >250ms or 5xx >0.4%.
Amanda (AlderBio): Thanks all — please send the enablement checklist and token spend after 1h. We'll collect logs for renewal convo.
Ben (CS): Will post perf snapshot and enablement doc. Good luck! :rocket:
